snippet.title: Cold Snap — Multiplayer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cold Snap is a fast-paced multiplayer snowball arena game built in Unreal Engine 5.
Jump into chaotic matches, throw snowballs, stun your opponents, and fight to be the last team standing.
Small project. Fast gameplay. Real fun.
Wishlist and more coming soon.

#ColdSnap #IndieGame #Multiplayer #GameDev
